responsibility: Defines the Darwin 9.x version-specific target overlay that switches this OS generation to DWARF2-first debugging and coordinates dsymutil-based debug bundle generation. It changes the preferred debugging type, assembler debug spec, and collect2/dsymutil invocation rules, customizes aligned common-symbol emission syntax for the older assembler/object format expectations, and sets the default minimum deployment target plus stack-check builtin policy for this release family. This header’s responsibility is release-specific Darwin debug and assembly/spec behavior layered over the generic Darwin configuration.
